name: export_editor_project_plan
description: Plan the open project export and report eligible ranges, review findings and the occurrence-level cut map when available. An ordinary plan lists under warnings what the output does not keep: reductions made by an encode, and cover art, attached files, chapters, timecode, or subtitle and data tracks that a copy leaves behind. A plain copy that keeps everything has no warnings field. A re-encode lists each audio track under audio_actions with its codec, bit_rate or bit_depth and reason. A multicam plan also lists under warnings, after the plan's own, what its program leaves out of its sources, such as the chapters of a camera other than the reference angle; plan.warnings keeps the plan's own. Still plans carry their warnings inside plan. When audio auto cannot copy a sound-only selection, applied names the conversion the export rules chose and warnings begin with what it gives up.

operation_id.description: Unique operation identifier; repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

output.description: Absolute local output path. Existing media destinations are protected.

require_camera_copy.description: Require zero encoded camera duration when generating stills.

mode.description: Defaults to Smart Trim for visible still picture. Other outputs use the native defaults.

quality.description: Use smaller, balanced or high for H.264 and HEVC. Use 422-lt, 422 or 422-hq for ProRes. For ordinary movie export, requires Re-encode. Still picture also supports these settings in Smart Trim.

audio_track_ordinal.description: Zero-based track within the ordinary source audio tracks.

use_reviewed_cuts.description: Use the native verified copy-boundary proposal for this ordinary export only. The timeline and its history stay intact.

audio_output.description: Multicam audio delivery. Separate tracks preserve lane order. Downmix renders the lanes into one mono or stereo track.

still_timing.description: Still picture timing. Held writes one independently decodable sample per visible hold. Cadence uses the authored frame schedule.

container.description: Explicit container for a still project export. Match the destination filename extension and selected tracks.

name: export_editor_project_render
description: Render the open project to the output path and report its occurrence-level cut map when available. The result reports warnings and audio_actions as export_editor_project_plan does. A written Smart Trim export of a sequence adds encoded_edge_results, one row for each encoded edge with its segment, from, to, encoded_bytes, target_bytes and retried, and for an AV1 edge max_qp, with first_attempt_bytes when it was retried. A written export adds written_warnings when writing changed something no plan could know, such as constant quality the encoder could not take or pictures decoded in software after the hardware decoder failed; the warnings of a plan and its render stay the same.
